name: Aryaduta Bandung
detail: I stayed in this hotel during my business trip in Bandung and had a 2 days meeting which has to be relocated in the last minutes. Surprisingly the hotel staff offered me the meeting room. They arranged everything perfectly, professionally and made my meetings went smoothly. Many thanks for all the staff who made this possible. Another thing I noticed is they are striving to make their client satisfied and this is something that I never found in other 5 stars hotels in Bandung. Definitely will stay in this hotel again, as always =)

name: Grand Hotel Preanger
detail: I knew this hotel had a long history and reputation. But in the midst of new competitions from more modern hotels, I had thought that this hotel would probably finding it hard to maintain its service and reputation. I WAS WRONG ! The service was outstanding beyond my expectation. I expected a 4-star service from an old hotel, instead me and family received (and observed) a 5-star service standard being carried out by the staffs. The breakfast quality was also in a high standard, and for the price it was way worth it! I had a wonderful stay, room was large, my baby daughter had fun running around, there was also a swimming pool. I love the location because it's actually within walking distance of some old spots like Braga or Sunda or Naripan. It's the real Bandung atmosphere any visitors would need to have. So anytime a friend asks for a recommended hotel in Bandung, if he/she is travelling with family, my answer will always be Preanger !

name: Ibis Bandung Trans Studio
detail: I booked 5 rooms for my family (9 aldults,1 Children). It was my first trip to bandung, Cleaniness of the hotel 10/10, Service 10/10, Comfort 10/10. Bolster is provided in the room!! Next to Trans studio mall, everything can found there for family dine in. Ibis hotel is far away from the attraction or places like Pasar baru. Everything was perfect about this hotel. FULLY RECOMMENDED for those looking for hotel in bandung. Tips for those booked this hotel, plan for itinery properly. Everywhere u go its going to be very bad jam. avoid weekends. AWESOME HOTEL!!

name: Crowne Plaza Bandung By IHG
detail: It was a last minute trip. So my wife and I decided to book a trip to Bandung, as we've never been there before. Weather was perfect. Shopping nothing to shout about as most of the things offered are imitations. Great POLO RL store which offered great deals at Jalan Braga. About the hotel. I've visited Indonesia many times before for work and leisure, have stayed in many nice hotels in Indonesia. To my surprise, services and greetings by Staff at Crowne Plaza Bandung is top notch compared to all the years of my travelling. Keep it up guys! Rooms, great size. Arrived and checked into a high floor 1702. Room was perfectly layed out, but found out a bad stench coming from the toilet. Was bearable when you close the toilet door, but when you enter the toilet......the smell is just unbearable. We stayed a night, and filed a complain the following day. Was transferred to room 1210. Was upgraded to a much bigger room, minus the toilet stench. To our surprise, was given a personal card for an apology accompanied by a serving of their cakes. Classy move and great job by the team!

name: Beehive Boutique Hotel
detail: So far puas bgt nginap di Beehive Bandung. Hotel sangat instagramable, harga terjangkau, dan lokasi strategis. Surprisingly menu sarapan juga enak dan tempat sarapan sangat ok..

name: Savoy Homann
detail: I made a booking for a childhood friend of mine whom recently got married and was in Bandung for their first together trip with his wife and their first Honeymoon! I booked the rooms for them for the Deluxe Room King Bed which includes breakfast. After some research and reading up the good reviews of this place. This iconic curved-shaped building, Savoy Homann Bidakara Hotel offers elegant rooms in Bandung’s city centre. The service of this hotel is above excellent. The rooms are very clean. Staying in Savoy Homann Bidakara Hotel and you will learn its full history here. Authentic rooms with interior designs just done too perfectly. The location is simply strategic, in front of Museum KAA, nearby to Braga street and near Masjid Agung Bandung. Distance to the airport is not too far away. This hotel met my friend’s expectation. Featuring free Wifi connections around the hotel vicinity was way too good for them. This is my friend’s review and feedback after they got back to Singapore. They loved this hotel and definitely would be a great memory for them here especially for his wife. She was just too amazed with the lovely great decorations done in the room for them! Really appreciate the kind staffs over the past day there. Nice place, warm service, great panorama, delicious food, good daily activities, strong wifi access and with the right person to call off this fantastic perfect honeymoon. The feeling there was like Oh My God!!! Fabulous!!! Fantastic!!! Everything is like heaven here, Said his wife. There are no words that can describe the place, simply beautiful, cozy and memorable experience here. They will definitely come back here when they visit Bandung again. They would like to once again wish the hotel staffs a Big Thank You. Simply amazing, warm and friendly! =)

name: Tokyo Cubo
detail: Tokyo Cubo is excellent for the value of money. The place itself is very close to the station (only 800m or about 15-20minutes of walking to get there) near the heart of Bandung so if you plan your day to get started from the center of Bandung, it's location is really helping. The staff is also really nice, very clean, you get towels, hot water for shower and for toilet necessity; there's soap--no shampoo though. The downside is no fridge in the common room at all so you can't really save any easy to stale food--the staff are willing to help though, they help me put down my yogurt in the cafe next door. The room can get really freezing but there's nothing you could do because it's a shared room, the other occupants may find it hot if you lower the ac so if you're not fond of cold that much (like me) you might want to bring extra blanket yourself. Wifi is nice, there's no breakfast included but there's a lot of food stall in front of the hostel. Thanks Tokyo cubo!
